The lathe machine is one of the important machine in small and medium-scale companies, PdM of lathe machines using AI & ML techniques could be the development of more accurate and robust models for early fault detection. While existing ML approaches failure prediction is based on historical data patterns, Regarding the precision and dependability of these forecasts, there might be space for improvement. In the present work, the loT based low cost data acquisition system is applied for condition monitoring, and data obtained is analyzed using AI & ML algorithms. This predictive approach enables maintenance to be performed before breakdowns occur, reducing downtime, minimizing costs, and improving overall efficiency and reliability of mechanical systems. This intersection of AI, ML, and mechanical engineering holds significant promise for optimizing maintenance practices and enhancing the performance of industrial machinery across various sectors.

articleTitle: Advanced Deep Learning Techniques for Accurate Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis: Optimization and Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Early detection of the Alzheimer's disease (AD) treatment is required to stop its progression. The doctors can begin their preventive treatment with the earliest possible detection. They insist that Alzheimer's is detected sooner and must be fast, accurate process. As a result, the focus of this work is on developing an automated framework to identify whether or not Alzheimer's disease exists using sagittal magnetic resonance images(MRI), which are seldom used in such tasks. This paper uses the convolutional neural network (CNN) as well as long short-term memory (LSTM)) to detect and categorise early-stage Alzheimier disease. MRI images are first passed to the pre-processing operation for removing noise in an image using median filtering technique. This will help in segmenting the image using binary segmentation after applying median filter. After that the classification model CNN and LSTM is executed where classifying process performed in better manner. And The bayesian optimization used here to improve quality of parameter. The performance matrices of accuracy, precision, recall and F-measure are used to justify the results obtained. Obtained results are discussed together with the state-of-the-art techniques. This relative study was obvious proofs the proposed model is suitable for irdentifying and clasiification of Alzheimer's disease.

articleTitle: Applications of Machine Learning in Detecting Unethical Sources of Raw Materials in Supply Chains in the Cosmetic Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The cosmetic industry maintains a global and complex supply chain network, where products composed of multiple raw ingredients are transported to numerous countries. Due to consumer pressure and regulatory requirements, ethical sourcing issues have attracted the attention of global consumers and businesses. This study proposes a machine-learning (ML)-oriented approach for identifying unethical sources in the cosmetic supply chain. We develop an ML-based framework by applying supervised learning, unsupervised learning and natural language processing (NLP), which includes text classification algorithms using a recommendation system to create training modules tailored to specific respondents. The proposed framework identifies unethical sourcing at any stage within the supply chain, thereby enhancing transparency, traceability, sustainability and business ethics as well as gaining the trust of consumers. While existing models have been successful in identifying certain unethical practices, they often face challenges such as limited scalability, high false positive rates, and the need for extensive labeled data. This study aims to address these limitations by developing a more robust and scalable machine learning framework. The results show that our ML models effectively detect potential unethical practices at early stages before harming reputations and adopt outlier detection in real-time monitoring or early warning systems with minimum configuration effort due to frequent changes in violation patterns or control mechanisms faced by practitioners. This study demonstrates that ML can aid governments and industries in implementing sustainable practices through stronger governance of business activities along their supply chains.

articleTitle: From Clusters to Scores: Unsupervised Acne Detection and Severity Assessment with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Acne detection and severity scoring remain challenging due to the scarcity of labeled data and inconsistencies caused by varying skin tones and lighting conditions. While recent advancements using deep learning models like CNNs have shown promise, they often rely heavily on large labeled datasets. This dependency limits their applicability, particularly in real-world settings where such data is scarce. Moreover, ensuring accurate classification across diverse image conditions continues to be a significant hurdle. To address these challenges, an unsupervised learning framework is proposed, utilizing the Kaggle Acne dataset of 680 unlabeled images. Our approach combines image normalization through NumPy and OpenCV with feature extraction using a pretrained ResNet model. The extracted features are clustered into five severity levels using K-Means, and clusters are labeled based on acne-related characteristics like redness intensity. This method bypasses the need for labeled data, offering a scalable solution for acne severity scoring that can support further dermatological research and clinical applications.

articleTitle: An Efficient Hybrid Red Panda Optimization-Similarity-Navigated Graph Neural Network with Blockchain Technology for Shared Electric Vehicle Charging
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Blockchain technology for shared electric vehicle (EV) charging makes use of a distributed ledger in handling different transactions which promotes authenticity in charging. However, this technology can be non-scalable at times which slows down the transaction rates as the scale increases in an organization and may also demand high computational as well as energy requirements which increases the inefficiency of the total system, the operating expenses of EV charging station, costs of energy utilized for charging, cost of maintenance and cost of station infrastructure may prove to be a weakness, impacting the feasibility of infrastructure deployment and upkeep expenses of the charging stations. To overcome these drawbacks, this paper proposes a hybrid method for blockchain technology with shared EV charging. The proposed approach combines the use of the Red Panda Optimization (RPO) with Similarity-Navigated Graph Neural Network (SNGNN). Hence, it is named as hybrid RPO-SNGNN approach. Reducing the operating cost of EV charging position and maximizes the security efficiency is the main aim of the proposed approach. To optimize scheduling and resource allocation by finding efficient paths by RPO and predict future demand and user behaviour patterns by SNGNN. By then, the proposed model has been put into practice on the MATLAB work platform and contrasted with other existing methods. The proposed technique outperforms all existing techniques, including Fuzzy-based Cross Hierarchical Reinforcement Q Learning (FCHRQL), Non-Dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm-Long Short-Term Memory Network (NSGA-II-LSTMN), and Ant Colony Optimization-Proximal Policy Optimization (ACO-PPO). The proposed method shows the operating cost of $550 and the security rate is 97%. From the result, the proposed approach operating cost is low and the security rate is high when compared to the existing approaches.

articleTitle: SmartBin+: Elevating Responsible Waste Disposal with Rewards
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Waste disposal inefficiency is a major concern in urban environments. This study introduces SmartBin+, an IoT-based waste management solution using Raspberry Pi for object detection via deep learning and facial recognition. The system, integrated with an Android app, tracks garbage trucks, monitors waste collection, and incentivizes responsible disposal through rewards. It also encourages community participation through events with additional rewards. Initial results indicate SmartBin+ improves waste disposal and awareness, though scalability and sensor accuracy are challenges. The system aims to streamline waste management while addressing technical and ethical concerns. Further research is needed to explore these areas for broader implementation.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Textile Fabric Defect Detection Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The Deep Learning technology known as Convolutional Neural Network (CNNs) are relatively new in the machine learning that has been employed for computer vision in the field of identification of defects in textile fabrics which needs to be done accurately and also autonomously. In this paper, we design a new machine learning specialized network to reduce the decision action for LSTM based on CNNs. That is a rather positive result; however, there are several critical concerns which can be addressed further: the differences in the texture of the fabric, the unpredictable nature of the defects' distribution, and the lack of large-labeled datasets. owing to the advancements in feature extraction and segmentation new approaches like transfer learning and deep CNN based models like U-net, Res net etc. have begun to solve the issue. Unfortunately, efforts to improve these systems' effectiveness and reliability are still challenged by issues related to high calculability costs, sample over-learning and the need for vast annotated dataset. Therefore, the aim of this work is to establish a defect detecting model with high reliability and generalization ability for different textile fabrics using CNN technique. Besides, this study helps in gaining insights into other strategies that could be deployed in order to leverage on those strategies while using slightly more complex mixed structures and modifying loss function.

articleTitle: A Survey on Remote Sensing-Based Climate Change Prediction Using Artificial Intelligence Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Climate change prognosis is one of the most important fields of study that has attracted much interest in the last decade because of its implication for environmental and social development. The developments in remote sensing technologies that deliver data on various climatic factors have been integrated with Artificial Intelligence techniques to improve climate change prediction models. This paper aims to review the research done between the years 2014–2024 and how the AI methods were applied along with the remote sensing data for climate change prediction. The survey covers different AI techniques, including machine learning, deep learning, combined approaches, and their application to vast RS datasets. Major trends and issues in this rapidly developing multidisciplinary area are discussed, and the strengths and weaknesses of different AI methods are compared. Furthermore, recent AI techniques used in remote-sensing-based climate change prediction include Neural Networks, Support Vector Machines (SVMs), Random Forests and Decision trees with physical climate models. However, these models have limitations like difficulties in handling heterogeneous information from different sensors, high computational costs, limited labelled datasets, and issues interpreting complicated AI model results. It also points to the directions for future research, noting that there is a need for better, more powerful and easily understandable AI frameworks to handle the issue of climate change. This paper seeks to give the reader an insight into the current state of AI in climate change prediction and the use of remote sensing data in this area of research.

articleTitle: Flexible and Secure EV Charging System Using Blockchain Technology with Namib Beetle Optimization and Continual Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The advancement in electric vehicles (EVs) has heightened the need to have better, safer, and smart charging solutions. There may be a problem with the implementing blockchain technology which may be a problem of scalability that can result in narrow space in providing services for multiple similar activities at different EV places at anyone time thus slowing down the rate of charging. This paper proposes a hybrid method for a flexible and secure smart charging system that combines blockchain technology with advanced techniques. The proposed method is the combined execution of together Namib beetle optimization algorithm (NBOA) and Continual Spatio- Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks (CSTGCN). Henceforth, it is called as NBOA-CSTGCN method. The objective of the proposed technique is to improve the efficiency and stability of EV charging systems. The NBOA is utilized to optimize EV charging schedules, ensuring a balanced load on the power grid. The CSTGCN is employed to predict and adapt to dynamic energy demand, facilitating efficient energy distribution across charging stations. By then, the proposed method is realized in MATLAB platform and associated to various existing approaches for example Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Adaptive Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (ANSGA-II), Krill Herd Algorithm (KHA). The proposed NBOA-CSTGCN method achieves the highest efficiency of 92.1 %, outperforming PSO (70.5%), ANSGA-II (78.2%), and KHA (86.7%). It also shows superior utility, with the Aggregator increasing from 2 in PSO to 7 in NBOA-CSTGCN, and the EV utility rising from 3.1 in PSO to 5.9 in NBOA-CSTGCN. These results demonstrate that NBOA-CSTGCN offers the best performance and effectiveness compared to existing methods.

articleTitle: Multimodal Biometric Authentication System using ECG Signals and Fingerprints
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In some of the aspects especially on security and protection it becomes important that the threats of digital crimes are addressed. Biometrics in general, which at the initial stage are pattern recognition systems, scan the unique characteristics using optical or electronic scanners. However, Non-university and noises in sensed data help in achieving higher GAR and FAR (False Acceptance Rates). Privacy and security are major issues in collecting and storing sensitive biometric data. Strict safeguards are required to prevent unauthorized access or breaches of Electrocardiography (ECG) data due to its sensitive nature and the fact that it is unique to each individual. Hence as solutions to these problems, a multimodal biometric system combining both the ECG signals and the fingerprint signals are suggested. Alterations to electrocardiogram signals over time can be caused by things like getting older or your health getting worse. An enormous obstacle is the fact that current systems can't consistently handle these long-term fluctuations. The proposed new deep architecture for multimodal learning integrates the feature vectors in a stacking as well as channel-wise method. One ought to notice that, during the course of the authentication process, Random Forest Classifier builds a number of decision trees. Knowing that the multimodal biometric system has higher accuracy and resisting power than the unimodal one, but at the same time has a number of problems embedded, when switching between them it is crucial.

articleTitle: Cloud-Powered Neural Networks for Sustainable Fishing Practices and Stock Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Sustainable fishing methods and efficient stock management are crucial considering growing environmental concerns; fishing practices and effective stock management are imperative. This research presents a novel approach that uses neural networks (NN) hosted in the cloud to transform sustainable fishing and stock management. This method trains NN to make predictions by combining several data sources, such as satellite images, weather patterns, and catch records. These models can reliably predict fish stocks' dynamics, giving stakeholders the information needed to make informed decisions. Crucial for real-time processing and storage of massive information is the scalability and flexibility offered by cloud infrastructure. This framework provides the appropriate usage of resources while simultaneously optimizing fishing tactics, which helps protect marine ecosystems. It demonstrates that method promotes sustainable fishing via thorough case studies and simulations. It provides a flexible and scalable solution to the problems confronting marine biodiversity and the fishing industry by combining advanced technology with ecological principles. To ensure a more egalitarian and sustainable future for fisheries management on a global scale, method is a giant leap forward in balancing commercial interests with environmental protection. Integrating data, ensuring sensors are accurate, managing huge datasets, managing regulatory compliance, and encouraging stakeholders to work together for sustainable practices are all challenges.

articleTitle: Investigating the Impact of Dataset Variants on Heart Disease Prediction Using Supervised Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In today's modern world due to lifestyle or ancestry, uncertain death or diagnosis of heart diseases have increased significantly not only among senior citizens but also among youths. The early detection of heart disease can help to prevent the risk of one's life. In this paper, authors have compared several machine learning algorithms such as Logistic Regression (LR), Random forest (RF), K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN), Naive Bayes (NB), Support Vector Machine (SVM) and applied these machine learning algorithms on three variants of the dataset i.e. original, scaled and resampled to understand the impact of these variants on prediction system result such that an enhanced and optimal model can be considered or brought into use based on their performance metrics. The dataset consists of 4240 instances and 16 attributes that went through various stages of data preprocessing to handle the anomalies present in the dataset and further where utilised for final training and testing on machine learning models. The authors produced an enhanced performance with accuracy of 85% of Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine and Random Forest models. Along with accuracy of 82% and 83 % of Naive Bayes and K-Nearest Neighbour models respectively on the original data. All these accuracies of machine learning algorithms were further compared with the accuracies of scaled and resampled dataset on similar algorithms to analyse and understand the impact of dataset variants. The outcome of the research paper encapsulates the concept of efficient working of Machine Learning Algorithms/Models that will help in early detection and prevention of Heart/Cardiovascular diseases.

articleTitle: Next-Gen Smart Pendant for Safe Navigation of the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Navigating everyday environments presents significant challenges for individuals who are visually impaired, with current assistive technologies such as ultrasonic sensor-based devices providing some relief, yet often falling short in areas like accuracy, affordability, and user-friendliness. Nationally, about 2.55% of the population aged 50 and above are visually impaired, with 0.36% classified as completely blind. This paper introduces a novel solution: a smart pendant that integrates advanced ultrasonic and infrared sensors with real-time data processing and adaptive user feedback mechanisms. The design draws inspiration from innovations like the smart cane developed by the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi, which uses ultrasonic sensors to detect obstacles above knee height and provides vibrational feedback to alert the user. Despite its effectiveness, this approach has limitations in accuracy and adaptability. The proposed pendant aims to enhance obstacle detection and navigation accuracy, addressing these challenges by integrating advanced sensors for precise detection and adaptive feedback. The device's objectives include improving navigation safety, reducing recharging frequency through optimized power management, and ensuring affordability and durability for broader accessibility.

articleTitle: A Word Segmentation Approach for Code-Mixed Handwritten Text
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the field of Online Handwriting Recognition (OHR), a several monolingual online handwriting recognition (OHR) systems are proposed for scripts such as Hindi, Chinese, Japanese, and English, Arabic, Bangla, Tamil, Punjabi, and many other languages. However, a limited number of investigators have conducted research with bilingual or multilingual OHR systems because the difficult aspect of these kind of systems is to determine the origin of scripts due to the presence of intermixed words. In this paper, a bilingual OHR system has been considered for the codemixed text containing words composed in two scripts: Roman (for the English language) and Devanagari (for the Hindi language). In order to transform handwritten code-mixed text to digital text, two major steps are involved: initially to recognize the script whether it belongs to Devanagari or Roman script and then to execute the corresponding script recognition engine for the purpose of digital text conversion. This work focuses on the part of segmentation required to extract complete words from the handwritten codemixed text. The output obtained can further be provided as input to the script identification algorithm. The concept of identification of delayed and connected strokes has been used for the purpose of segmentation and results of the proposed algorithm shows 92.975% accuracy of the system.

articleTitle: Quaternion Generative Adversarial Networks for loT based Chronic Kidney Disease Detection using Greylag Goose Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Chronic disease detection using loT devices involves leveraging secure, decentralized networks to collect, store, and share patient health data. Ensures data integrity, security, and transparency, while loT devices provide real-time health monitoring. This combination enhances data accuracy, facilitates seamless information sharing among healthcare providers, and supports personalized, efficient care for chronic conditions. But the existing methods have lot of disadvantages such as, low precision, low accuracy and high error rate. To overcome these problems, Quaternion Generative Adversarial Networks with Greylag Goose Optimization Algorithm (QGADN-GGOA) is proposed. In this, loT based input data is taken from a dataset such as MIMIC III dataset. It pre-processed data using Correlation Coefficients with Min-Max Normalization (CC-MMN), Following that Feature selection using Sea-Horse Optimizer (S-HO) and classification Quaternion Generative Adversarial Networks (QGAN) and the optimization using Greylag Goose Optimization Algorithm (GGOA) for detecting the type of Chronic Disease Management and to find the No CKD AND CKD. The introduced system is executed in python. The efficiency of the proposed QGADN-GGOA is analyzed using a datasets and attains 99.9% accuracy, 0.1 % error rate and O.ls PT and attains better results compared with the existing methods. This demonstrates the approach's superior efficiency and the potential for future progress in the field.

articleTitle: Regulatory Compliance and User Trust: Balancing Innovation and Security in AI-Driven Online Payment Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: To enhance user experience and security, integrating AI bots into online payment systems offers both potential and challenges. This study evaluates the complicated world of AI-powered online payment systems, stressing the main issues raised and innovation solutions recommended. Main challenges include maintaining the trust of users in AI, cybersecurity guidelines will implement to safeguard private financial data from growing threats and enhancing system efficiency to handle high transaction volumes while maintaining accuracy and speed. With the advancements in the technology and the usage of the Artificial intelligence usage the users are very comfortable in trusting the use of various features in doing online transactions as well. We al are aware of this these days that going to the banks for the smallest of the activity is becoming hassle but with the help of all these features the KYC can also be done online using the applications and the use of AI. The major concerns such as user's trust, cybersecurity, system efficiency and regulatory compliances are being resolved by number of approaches to solve the issues with the help of AI tools, such as predictive data used for improving user experience, NLP serving as customer service with AI capabilities, and ML algorithms for fraud identification and prevention. This investigation concerns artificial intelligence (AI) and how such policies can be implemented to optimize users' management and legal requirements adherence. It further carries out the literature review regarding the methods of analytics integration into the bot's evolution and transformations within the payment systems. The complete roadmap is given to the stakeholders how to confront the challenges of Artificial Intelligence as well as exploit its potentials to create safe, effective and simple-to-use electronic transactions. The main objective of the study is giving the opportunities, challenges, and solutions regarding usage of Artificial Intelligence in online payment processing.

articleTitle: Enhancing Communication and Data Transmission Security in RAG Using Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) by integrating external knowledge sources, enabling more useful information and generating accurate responses. This paper explores RAG's architecture and applications, combining generator and retriever models to access and utilize vast external data repositories. While RAG holds significant promise for various Natural Language Processing (NLP) processes like dialogue generation, summarization, and question answering, it also presents unique security challenges that must be addressed to ensure system integrity and reliability. RAG systems face several security threats, including data poisoning, model manipulation, privacy leakage, biased information retrieval, and harmful outputs generation. Generally, in the traditional RAG application, security threat is one of the major concerns. To tighten the security system and enhance the efficiency of the model on processing more complex data this paper outlines key strategies for securing RAG-based applications to mitigate these risks paper outlines key strategies for securing RAG-based applications to mitigate these risks. Ensuring data security through filtering, sanitization, and provenance tracking can prevent data poisoning and enhance the quality of external knowledge sources. Strengthening model security via adversarial training, input validation, and anomaly detection improves resilience against manipulative attacks. Implementing output monitoring and filtering techniques, such as factual verification, language moderation, and bias detection, ensures the accuracy and safety of generated responses. Additionally, robust infrastructure and access control measures, including secure data storage, secure APIs, and regulated model access, protect against unauthorized access and manipulation. Moreover, this study analyzes various use cases for LLMs enhanced by RAG, including personalized recommendations, customer support automation, content creation, and advanced search functionalities. The role of vector databases in optimizing RAG-driven generative AI is also discussed, highlighting their ability to efficiently manage and retrieve large-scale data for improved response generation. By adhering to these security measures and leveraging best practices from leading industry sources such as Databricks, AWS, and Milvus, developers can ensure the robustness and trustworthiness of RAG-based systems across diverse applications.

articleTitle: Live Stock Price Detection using ARMA-ARIMA Model with RNN Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Stock market prices show characteristics similar to those of fractals, according to the Fractal Market Hypothesis (FMH), and these characteristics are attributed to varying time horizons and investor information. This occurs because every trader is relying on the same information. Main challenge focused here is Non-stationarity Data. A common requirement of used models is that data should be stationary, but in real-world applications changing statistical properties are often present. Seasonality and trends: Business environment that contains time series data always represents seasonal variations or long-term trends. Autoregressive Moving Averages (ARMAs) and Autoregressive Integrated Moving Averages (ARIMAs) have been developed for stock markets where the market becomes unstable and investors exchange information. Since the outcome of the preceding movement is taken as input conviction to the relevant step, the proposed method uses the Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) for classifying a particular time sequence. This study combines ARMA with ARIMA to model daily stock indexes on the NASDAQ stock exchange for 2022 and 2023. In the proposed work, the examine can be used to quote the upcoming months of the year and show profit and loss for the stock market over the year. NASDAQ stock exchange is a non-fractal market and an efficient market according to the proposed method to predict it.

articleTitle: Enhancing Fish Disease Classification in Bangladeshi Aquaculture through Transfer Learning, and LIME Interpretability Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Fish disease classification is an essential component of aquaculture management and is essential to preserving the sustainability and health of fish populations. Research on fish diseases has been done sparingly, and each study has certain limitations. There isn't a single study that uses an image classification approach and cutting-edge methods like transfer learning from a Bangladeshi perspective. We classified the freshwater image diseases in Bangladesh through research using the Inceptionv3, ResNet-50, DenseNet-121, and EfficientNetB3 transfer learning models. We have customized the model in light of our findings. Among all the models, the Inceptionv3 model performed well. The validation and testing accuracy of the model is 95.51% and 82.51% respectively, which shows the highest testing accuracy. The model also performed better in terms of precision, recall, and f-score than others; the performance is 830/0,82%, and 82%, respectively. The collected dataset applied here is limited and imbalanced. We performed a data augmentation technique to increase the dataset in our research. Further investigation to evaluate the model for imbalanced data are kappa and MCC, both of which serve as insightful indicators of classification robustness and efficacy. The best Kappa and MCC values obtained by the InceptionV3 model are 0.8006 and 0.8018. Furthermore, we explore the integration of explainable AI techniques, such as LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations), to enhance the transparency and trustworthiness of classification models in aquaculture.

articleTitle: Cloud-Enabled Patient Acuity Prediction Utilizing Decision Trees in Smart ICU Nurse Assignment Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research introduces a new method for improving Intensive Care Units (ICUs) nurse assignment using cloud computing and Decision Trees (DTs )-based patient acuity prediction models. Effective and timely care delivery is dependent on the efficient allocation of nursing resources, which is becoming more important due to the growing complexity of patients' situations in ICUs. To integrate patient data from many sources seamlessly the proposed system uses cloud infrastructure to process and analyze data in real-time. To proactively identify high-risk situations, use DTs algorithms to forecast patient acuity levels using a variety of clinical indicators. Optimizing staffing levels and improving patient outcomes which incorporates these predictions into the nurse assignment process. Through a case study performed in a real-world ICUs improves nurse efficiency and the quality of patient care. The findings of this study highlight the promise of decision support systems hosted in the cloud for improving the delivery of healthcare in ICUs.

articleTitle: Advanced Wheat Disease Detection: Utilizing an Integrated CNN-SVM Model for Leaf Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) has significantly advanced gender recognition technology, which automates the identification of a person's gender from various forms of data. This study explores the development and evaluation of a gender recognizer system leveraging the EfficientNet B0 architecture and transfer learning. The model processes input images through several steps, including dataset preprocessing, feature extraction, and classification. The effectiveness of the model is demonstrated through performance metrics such as precision, recall, F1 score, and accuracy. The results indicate a high accuracy rate of 93%, with precision and recall scores showcasing the model's robust and reliable performance in predicting gender. Additionally, the ethical considerations, including privacy concerns and potential biases in gender recognition algorithms, are discussed, emphasizing the need for fairness and transparency in the deployment of such technologies.

articleTitle: An AI Framework Model for Smart Prediction of Ripeness in Regional Fruits and Vegetables
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: It is imperative to take great measures of nutrition facts to stay away from different illnesses. The Standard admission of various nutrition facts are basic for keeping the correct equilibrium of nutrition content in the human body. In this project, a web-based application for estimating the condition of fruits/vegetables and nutrition facts of food improving individual's utilization propensities for wellness is developed. Additionally, by incorporating ripeness level estimation, the project offers a more comprehensive understanding of the life cycle and quality of fruits and vegetables, enhancing its utility and practicality. The nutrition facts portion of a fruit or vegetable is distinguished utilizing standard picture dataset utilizing various advances such as pre-processing, attribute extraction, training and categorization using shape and size with the help of machine learning techniques. Fruit or vegetable nutrition facts object dimensions are determined using image processing techniques. The final step is to estimate the nutrition facts (calories,protein,iron,calcium,potassium) in the given fruit or vegetable and provide the users, patients with optimum solutions for fruit or vegetable intake. This project is about Fruits-Vegetable classification and nutrition facts prediction. For this proposed system Convolutional Neural Network, KNN and Random Forest are employed. The CNN model achieves a higher accuracy of99.21. Hence the CNN model performs better than other models in an Integrated Approach to Fruits and Vegetables. It is a simple web application that every user can use it. User need to upload the image of any fruit or vegetable. Our system will automatically classify the Image and it will give you the prediction about the name of fruit or vegetable, and now it includes one another module which will give the nutrition facts of the predicted image.

articleTitle: DNA Driven Mechanism for Genetic Ciphering to Protect IoT Images
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: To secure smart ecosystem devices, a groundbreaking and lightweight encryption technique has been created by this research, drawing inspiration from DNA principles. The use of secret codes, SHA-256 hashing, and the natural randomness of DNA sequences are integrated into the approach to produce robust keys that are impervious to attacks and difficult to decode. The avalanche effect, a vital component of cryptography, is addressed, ensuring that even minor alterations in plaintext result in markedly different ciphertext, thereby thwarting pattern detection by potential attackers. Exceptional performance has been exhibited by the algorithm through extensive evaluation across key metrics, such as key size, encryption speed, resistance to distortion, and efficacy of the avalanche effect, exceeding traditional encryption methods.

Author Keywords: original image PSNR and Mean Squared Error

articleTitle: Innovative Image Preprocessing Methods for Enhancing OCR Accuracy in Number Plate Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The accuracy of Optical Character Recognition (OCR) systems in number plate detection is critically dependent on the quality of image preprocessing techniques. This research introduces a novel hybrid preprocessing approach that integrates adaptive thresholding with edge detection and morphological operations to enhance the performance of OCR systems in recognizing vehicle number plates. The study evaluates various combinations of preprocessing techniques, including the integration of thresholding method with Canny and Sobel filter, to optimize the OCR pipeline. Experimental results demonstrate a significant increase in OCR accuracy, particularly under challenging conditions such as low light and high noise levels. The proposed hybrid approach outperforms traditional methods, offering a robust solution for improving the reliability and efficiency of number plate recognition systems in real-world applications.

articleTitle: Collaborative Search With Knowledge Sharing And Summarization
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A collaborative search engine is used for a group of users who want to search information together for various group activities. This will be time saving as the users can split the work between them. Summarization is the process of condensing a document into a shorter version which will contain the important details about the document. This will be useful to quickly get the main ideas without having to go through the entire document. Our main aim is to combine collaborative search with document summarization so that it will be helpful when users in a group want to quickly read the summary of the documents whenever required. In the collaborative search, the results will be re-ranked based on the user's interaction with the system, so that feedback driven ranking of results is attained and the users in a session will be able to view pages that were even ranked by their co-mates. This re-raking process is done by obtaining the user's interest on a particular page using decision logic and updating it in the priority queue. User's meta-data like page size, click-through rate, time spent and scrolling speed of the document will be calculated and these will be used as parameters for the decision logic to find the interest level of the user. Extractive summarization is implemented with the concept of Maximum Independent Set. The raw text document is first converted into a graph having its sentences as nodes and the edge weight is the similar instances between sentences. Then graph MIS is identified and removed after which the top-n sentences are fetched upon its eigenvector centrality value and the summary is generated.

articleTitle: Advancements in Disaster Prediction: A Systematic Review of Earthquake, Flood, and Cyclone Forecasting Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Disaster prediction has made progress through the integration of machine learning and deep learning in various types of natural disasters. This comprehensive review provides an in-depth review of recent advances in earthquake, flood, and storm prediction methods. We describe major methods, including global convolutional LSTM for earthquake prediction, hybrid CNN-LSTM model for flood prediction, and dual-branch spatiotemporal fusion network for cyclone detection. Despite this progress, many challenges remain, such as data integration, model performance, and computational limitations. This review outlines these challenges and examines the benefits of various approaches to address them. New techniques, such as federal work for flood forecasting and deep coordination for storm forecasting, are discussed in detail, including their advantages and disadvantages. We also highlight the need for improved data collection, prioritization, and algorithm selection to increase forecast accuracy and reliability. This review integrates recent research findings to provide a better understanding of current approaches and suggests future research and development directions for damage forecasting.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning Models for Early Skin Cancer Detection Using 3D Total Body Photography
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Skin cancer presents a significant public health challenge, with early detection being crucial in mitigating its life-threatening implications. This study explores the application of deep learning models for early skin cancer detection using 3D Total Body Photography (TBP) images from the ISIC dataset. The dataset includes single-lesion crops from a large and diverse population, enabling comprehensive algorithm training. The study evaluates four models: EfficientNet-B0, CNN, ResNet50, and Inception V3. Among these, EfficientNet-B0 achieved the highest accuracy of 98%, underscoring the importance of model selection in skin cancer diagnostics. The results emphasize the potential of deep learning models in aiding early detection and reducing mortality from skin cancer.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Retrieval Augmented Generation Chatbot for Contextually-Aware Conversations to Guide High School Students
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The growth of Large Language Models (LLM) has showcased both their potential and limitations in domain- specific applications. A significant limitation is their tendency to confidently present false information, known as hallucination, which compromises the integrity of their outputs. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) systems mitigate this by enhancing the Large Language Models' ability to retrieve accurate, source-specific knowledge. Many American students begin preparing for college applications in middle school, seeking guidance on planning their high school years to achieve personal goals. The diversity in students' interests, skills, and circumstances often results in an overwhelming amount of information and advice. This research introduces a novel RAG chatbot designed to provide personalized assistance to high school students using their course guide as the primary source document. By integrating a high school course guide with a RAG system, the chatbot delivers relevant suggestions, helping students navigate their educational paths with greater confidence and precision. This system aims to minimize the risk of hallucination by ensuring that responses are grounded in the accurate and relevant information contained within the course guide. Consequently, it addresses the crucial need for personalized educational planning, enabling students to make informed decisions that align with their unique aspirations and circumstances. This research highlights the transformative potential of RAG systems in educational contexts, offering a reliable tool to support students in their academic and personal growth.

articleTitle: Quantized Wavelet Dilated Convolutional Neural Network Based Intelligent Surveillance System for Public Safety in IoT Security Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Smart cities have produced vast amounts of surveillance video data that can be processed to identify anomalies since the introduction of visual sensors. A novel Quantized Wavelet Auxiliary Encoder Self-Attention Dilated Convolutional Neural Network with Gold Rush Optimizer (QWAESDCNN-GRO) designed to enhance security and reduce crime potential. Through the integration of the Quantized Discrete Haar Wavelet Transform (QDHWT), frame-level features have been extracted. Subsequently, the recovered features are fed to the Auxiliary Guided Knowledge Encoder-Decoder (AGED), which uses them to rank the features. These features are then sent to the Self-Attention Causal Dilated Convolutional Neural Network (SACDCNN) with Gold Rush Optimization (GRO) for anomaly detection. Performance indicators including Fl-score, recall, accuracy, precision, and AUC are compared with those of earlier techniques in order to assess the effectiveness of the recommended strategy. Using the UCF-Crime dataset, the model achieved an accuracy of 99.87% and an error rate of 0.021%. On the Hockey Fights dataset, it obtained an accuracy of 99.88% and an error rate of 0.019%.

Author Keywords: Self-Attention Causal Dilated Convolutional Neural Network

articleTitle: Streamlining Software Development: A Comprehensive Study on CI/CD Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) automation have emerge as critical for modern-day software development. Despite its blessings, demanding situations including integration complexity, inconsistent trying out environments, and deployment troubles persist. Recent strategies like superior containerization, cloud-based scaling, and improved testing frameworks intention to address those issues. This take a look at implements an self sustaining CI/CD pipeline using gear such as Jenkins, GitHub, and SonarQube to automate processes which include coding, building, checking out, and deployment. By addressing those demanding situations, our proposed objective is to enhance efficiency and reliability in the software program development lifestyles cycle, allowing improvement teams to seamlessly add features and solve problems.

articleTitle: Enhanced UAV Delivery System with Image-Based Authentication
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Considering the rapid growth of the aviation sector, the shift towards sustainability embarks on a new era of modern logistics where UAVs also known as Unmanned Aerial Vehicle plays a major role. The UAVs are most commonly used for surveillance, mapping, surveying, rescue operations, entertainment as well as logistical purposes. The Logistical application includes the delivery of goods from one place to another. The utilisation of UAVs for Logistical applications not only reduces the time of commute but also reduces the carbon footprint. The UAV can be made autonomous where the path planning is done by setting the waypoints the UAV should follow to reach the destination, ensuring an optimised travel path. The Autonomous UAV helps in reducing manpower and ensures ultimate-mile delivery. The UAV can maneuver through rough terrain and harsh environments making it suitable for logistical application. The UAV can be tacked with the help of an onboard GPS module that is connected to the flight controller. Ensuring the secure delivery of the package is one of the major issues, which can ensured by the proposed methodology “Enhanced UAV Delivery System with Image-based Authentication”. The proposed methodology ensures that the package of the Autonomous UAV reaches the recipient. The onboard microcomputer processes the input data from the Camera, attached to the UAV, with the help of a specific Face Detection Software, designed to identify the recipient's face by comparing it to the predefined input provided to the microcomputer. The significant match of the recipient's face then triggers the package delivery/drop mechanism that is connected to the onboard microcomputer of the UAV. By employing the stated methodology the efficiency of the Autonomous Delivery of goods can be improved significantly.

articleTitle: High Performance Cloud Ready Parallel Batch Processing using Auto Scaling Containers and Queue Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of the current batch processing systems as well as to reduce cost and shorten processing times, an enhanced parallel processing strategy has been introduced. Existing Batch system are running in dedicated servers and at most one Job can be processed at a time. Which results in higher costs. Also, batch jobs run in sequential to avoid duplicate processing of data so it will take more time. Where as in our proposed system we use queue to avoid duplicate and containers to achieve parallel processing and once job completed containers will be decommissioned and no need to pay for cloud provider when not in use. Hence, this proposed system is using queue mechanisms like RabbitMQ and Multiple containers(pods) all the containers can run parallelly and get inputs from queue so that duplicate processing will not happen in parallel processing to complete the job faster. This is achieved by Auto scaling mechanism, and the paper proposes a novel algorithm called Chunk Optimized Processing based on Queue Length (COPQL). Particularly, one of the main parts of this system is the Initiator, whose job it is to read data from source and push messages(data) into the queue as chunks, especially the primary keys from the database. RabbitMQ queues has been utilized by the proposed system, which are configured with specific topics or queues for each job type and set up as a 3-node cluster to ensure fault tolerance. Multiple processors (containerized nodes) have been included in the system for each job type, which can automatically scale based on the new Chunk Optimized Processing based on Queue Length (COPQL) algorithm. Each processor reads a chunk, consisting of a group of primary keys, retrieves the corresponding data from the source database, performs the necessary business processing, and updates the status in the Batch DB upon completion. It is highly notable that other features include a retry mechanism for handling failures in specific chunks, a caching mechanism to improve processing speed, and a tracking mechanism to monitor the batch process and to generate final reports. Importantly, the COPQL algorithm has been designed to achieve Low cost (serverless model) and minimal processing time for batch. Particularly, the system has been implemented by using Python, and the results have been analyzed based on weighted sum completion time and the effect of the number of tasks per user.

articleTitle: Depth Wise Separable Convolutional Neural Network with Context Axial Reverse Attention Based Sentiment Analysis on Movie Reviews
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Sentiment Analysis (SA) in movie reviews involves using natural language processing techniques to determine the sentiment expressed in reviews. This analysis helps in understanding the overall audience sentiment towards a movie, categorizing reviews as positive, negative, or neutral. It's useful for filmmakers, marketers, and audiences. The existing methods does not provide sufficient accuracy, error rate and complexity was increased. To overcome the aforementioned problem, Depth Wise Separable Convolutional Neural Networks with Context Axial Reverse Attention Network (DWSCNN-CARAN) is proposed for accurately classifying SA in movie reviews. In this input image is taken from two datasets such as IMDB dataset and Polarity dataset. The pre-processing is done using six steps namely, Cleaning, Tokenization, Case Folding, Normalization, Stop Word Elimination, and Stemming for the purpose of removing noises. Following that feature extraction are done using Bag-Of-Words and Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (BOW-TF-IDF). After that classification are done using Depth Wise Separable Convolutional Neural Networks with Context Axial Reverse Attention Network (DWSCNN-CARAN)for classifying the AS in movie reviews. The efficiency of the proposed DWSCNN-CARAN-BOA is analyzed using a dataset and attains 99.94% accuracy, 98.76% recall and attains better results compared with the existing methods. In the future, this approach will use the adversarial instances it generated to conduct adversarial training and assess the potential improvement in classification performance. It also looks into the possibilities of creating adversarial examples at the word and sentence levels by combining structured knowledge from high-quality knowledge bases.

Author Keywords: Bag-Of-Words and Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency
Depth Wise Separable Convolutional Neural Networks with Context Axial Reverse Attention Network

articleTitle: Corn Plant Disease Detection at Initial Stage Using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Zea mays, the scientific name for corn, is the world's third most important plant-based food source, employed in a variety of industries such as food, biofuel, and industrial applications. Despite its crucial role, corn agriculture faces significant challenges particularly its vulnerability to diseases at different stages of growth. Early detection is critical for sustaining crop health, increasing production, and assuring farmer's financial security. This research compares three advanced convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures-ResN etV2, DenseNet-121, and EfficientNetV2B3 for identifying corn leaf disease. With the growing importance of precision agriculture, timely and accurate disease detection for crop health and productivity. We implemented a detailed image processing pipeline to enhance leaf region segmentation in the images that began with clustering techniques to generate a leaf mask, effectively distinguishing the leaf regions from the background. Further refinement involved applying a median blur to smooth the edges and thresholding to delineate the leaf more clearly. To ensure maximum clarity, contrast enhancement applied on the leaf regions to distinguishable from the background. This meticulous preprocessing step was crucial in preparing the images for the CNN models, ensuring that the features related to diseases were prominently highlighted. We tested ResNetV2, DenseNet-121, and EfficientNetV2B3 on their ability to identify various corn leaf diseases, focusing on accuracy and computational efficiency. DenseNet-121 achieved the highest accuracy of 98.47%, outperforming ResNetV2 with 97.63% and EfficientNetV2B3 with 94.61%, while also maintaining fewer parameters. These findings offer valuable insights for agricultural image analysis and precision agriculture, highlighting the effectiveness of different CNN architectures.

articleTitle: Unlocking Alzheimer's: A Squeezenet-Based Approach for Automated Diagnosis Across Disease Stages
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The neurodegenerative disorder known as Alzheimer's Disease (AD), which is carried on by the death of brain cells are characterised by memory loss and cognitive decline. The complexity of the brain's structure and functioning makes early identification of AD challenging, despite the fact that research into the illness has considerably increased recently. In this work, Multiclass Classification of Alzheimers disease stages using Squeeznet based approach for automated diagnosis is presented. This work mainly focused on multiple stages of AD classification. For identifying the phases, including Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI), EMCI (Early MCI), Late MCI (LMCI), and CN (Cognitively Normal), the SqueezeNet with Harris Hawks Optimisation approach (HHO-SqueezeNet) is described. These feature vectors are processed using the MRI, and the aforementioned iTask is subjected to the PCA technique for the feature dimension. Additionally, we employ the CML-ELN strategy for each job in order to account for the quantity of related tasks. As a result, only performance metrics such as model accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, precision, and recall that may be pertinent to the issue are employed. It will be feasible to classify the appropriate subjects. With relation to SqueezeNet, the MTL algorithm created in this work is quicker, more effective, and most like an AD treatment.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Diabetes Prediction Accuracy using Various Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Diabetes Mellitus is an illness caused by a ineffective insulin management in the human body. Untreated diabetes, characterized by elevated glucose levels, poses serious health risks, including heart complications, kidney dysfunction, hypertension, vision impairment and multi-organ damage. Early prediction is vital for effective intervention. This project aims to enhance diabetes prediction accuracy by employing diverse machine learning techniques such as Logistic Regression(LR), SVM, GBDT and Random Forest (RF) on patient datasets. Risk factors such as age, obesity, sedentary lifestyle, genetic predisposition, poor dietary habits, and hypertension contribute to diabetes mellitus. Recent techniques, like ensemble learning and advanced hyper-parameter tuning, have been explored to improve predictive accuracy. However, challenges such as handling imbalanced datasets, feature selection, and model over-fitting persist. Hospitals employ comprehensive data analysis for precise diagnosis and tailored treatment plans. The primary objective of this project is to build a reliable, accurate model by overcoming these challenges through optimized algorithm selection, feature engineering, and rigorous cross-validation.

articleTitle: Optimized Attention with Sparse Graph Convolutional Network Based Tumor Segmentation Using Field Programmable Gated Array
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning (DL) techniques have become increasingly intriguing for segmentation and classification. A convolutional neural network (CNN) needs to do multiple upsampling operations in order to get the input image from the characteristics map during breast Tumor (BT) detection. In this study, a field programmable gate array (FPGA) for BT segmentation using optimized Residual group attention network based Sparse Graph Convolutional Neural Network (RGAN-SGCNN) is introduced. The optimal trade-off between accuracy and hardware complexity is determined by the FPGA implementation of RGAN-SGCNN taking into account both fixed and floating point operations. Several adder and multiplier units, which demand more space and power, are typically needed for the RGAN-SGCNN network model. A carrier select quality-efficient approximate multiplier with low power binary adder (QEAM-LPBA) is therefore used as the foundation for an optimized approximate multiplier. Furthermore, the Running city game optimizer (RCGO) is presented as a means of fine-tuning the network model's parameters. The proposed model demonstrated high efficiency in an experimental scenario, with an accuracy of 98.89. The proposed model's FPGA design, with a power consumption of 0.32W and a LUT of 12,167, demonstrated efficiency through experimental findings.

articleTitle: Edge Federated Learning for Smart HealthCare Systems: Applications and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The rapid advancement of technology in healthcare has led to an unprecedented increase in the amount of medical data being generated, from patient records to real-time monitoring data. While this data holds immense potential for improving patient care and outcomes, it also raises significant challenges in terms of security and privacy, especially within the framework of smart healthcare systems. Traditional data processing approaches often require the centralization of data, which can expose sensitive information to potential breaches. In smart healthcare systems, the integration of Edge Computing with Federated Learning offers a transformative approach to data analysis and processing. EFL leverages the computational capabilities allowing data to be processed closer to its source. The combination of these technologies holds the potential to revolutionize how healthcare data is managed, analyzed, and utilized, paving the way for more personalized and efficient healthcare delivery. This survey report delves into the evolution of FL and edge computing, exploring their convergence in the context of smart healthcare. It examines various applications of EFL within healthcare, from remote patient monitoring to predictive analytics and personalized medicine. Additionally, the report addresses the challenges and concerns associated with EFL, such as data heterogeneity, communication overhead, and the need for robust security measures. Finally, it outlines future research directions that could further enhance the effectiveness and adoption of EFL in smart healthcare systems, underscoring its potential to reshape the landscape of medical data processing.

articleTitle: Analysis of EMG Parameters to Predict Fatigue during Exercise in Young Athletes
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the contemporary world, healthcare is essential for both developed and developing countries. Each emerging country benefits greatly from the latest advancements in the healthcare industry. More than 71% of the population in India suffers from muscular abnormalities, so the focus of the research is primarily on diagnosing muscular issues in athletes. Since athletes are more likely to experience pulls and strains in the targeted area, the study focuses predominantly on athletes to identify muscular variations at the targeted location. The majority of sportsmen have experienced upper and lower back discomfort as well as neck pain. Tendinitis, sprains, strains, and fractures are among the numerous conditions that occur in the everyday world of athletes. Our focus is mostly on the soleus muscle, which is important for athletes. Since the soleus muscle is where high levels of stress and strain accumulate, it explicitly serves as a diagnostic point of contact. The EMG amplifier is employed to analyze the electrical activity of the muscles; the amplifier channel may change depending on the data required. Myoware sensor is used to acquire the raw EMG, and the processing and feature extraction clearly defines the properties of the muscles obtained for their pre- and post-event states.

articleTitle: Enhancing Retail Sales Forecasting with Optimized Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In retail sales forecasting, accurately predicting future sales is crucial for inventory management and strategic planning. Traditional methods like LR often fall short due to the complexity of sales data, which includes seasonality and numerous product families. Recent advancements in machine learning (ML) provide more robust alternatives. This research benefits from the power of ML, particularly Random forest (RF), Gradient Boosting (GB), Support Vector Regression (SVR), and XGBoost, to improve prediction accuracy. Despite advancements, a significant gap exists in handling complex datasets with high seasonality and multiple product families. The proposed solution involves implementing and optimizing a RF model, leveraging hyperparameter tuning through randomized search cross-validation. This approach addresses the complexities of the dataset, capturing intricate patterns that traditional methods miss. The optimized RF model achieved an R-squared value of 0.945, substantially higher than the initial RF model and traditional LR, which had an R-squared of 0.531. The model reduced the root mean squared logarithmic error (RMSLE) to 1.172, demonstrating its superior predictive capability. The optimized RF model did better than cutting-edge models like Gradient Boosting (R-squared: 0.942), SVR (R-squared: 0.940), and XGBoost (R-squared: 0.939), with more minor mean squared error (MSE) and mean absolute error (MAE) numbers. The results demonstrate that the optimized RF model excels in forecasting retail sales, handling the dataset's complexity with higher accuracy and reliability. This research highlights the importance of advanced ML techniques in predictive analytics, offering a significant improvement over traditional methods and other contemporary models.

articleTitle: Cloud-Based AI Solutions for Early Wound Infection Detection and Treatment Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Wound infections are a major problem for healthcare systems worldwide. Infections cause patients to remain in the hospital longer., which increases healthcare expenses and negatively impacts their health outcomes. For patient care to be successful, it is crucial to identify these illnesses quickly and treat them appropriately. Recent developments in cloud computing and artificial intelligence (AI) have encouraged optimism for the potential of these technologies to improve wound infection diagnosis and treatment. Within healthcare systems, this research outlines a new method for early wound infection diagnosis and treatment recommendations generation using cloud-based AI algorithms. The proposed method employs machine learning to appropriately detect early indications of infection by analyzing a variety of patient data inputs, such as wound features, vital signs, laboratory findings, and medical history. Also, healthcare practitioners may benefit from real-time monitoring and decision assistance due to cloud-based architecture's easy interaction with existing electronic health record (HER) systems. The system is designed with a dynamic feedback loop that can be updated with fresh data inputs to make it more accurate and flexible. The proposed cloud-based AI system has been thoroughly tested and proven reliable in improving the early diagnosis and treatment of wound infections. This has led to better patient outcomes and more efficient use of healthcare resources. Key challenges include data privacy issues, the integration of diverse technologies, the reliability of precise forecasts, and maintaining system resiliency in changing environments.

articleTitle: Predicting Cardiovascular Disease Through IoT and Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Today, heart disease affects many people and is a leading cause of death worldwide. Cardiovascular disease, also known as CVD, is the leading cause of morbidity and mortality, accounting for more than 70% of all deaths. According to the 2017 Global Burden of Disease Study, CVD causes 43% of all deaths. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), heart disease and stroke will kill 23.6 million people worldwide by 2030. This situation is difficult to predict when there are no symptoms and requires prior knowledge of the patient. A brilliant method called the Internet of Things captures the information that patients need and stores it in cloud servers. Many studies have been done on heart diseases; however, the accuracy of the prediction is very low. To solve this problem, we have created a revolutionary IoT-smart solution. Current healthcare systems are based on IoT devices and distributed systems, and they face serious problems due to insufficient distribution of patient information, which can lead to wrong diagnosis and treatment decisions. This paper uses a combination of ResNet197 and Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM). ResNet197 is a deep residual neural network with 197 layers for CVD diagnosis. This technology outperforms existing models for predicting heart disease with 99.25% accuracy, 96.68% accuracy, 93.97 sensitivity, 96.96 F1 score, 98.69% accuracy, and 97.8% return.

articleTitle: BankRuptcyML: A Sustainable System for Company Bankruptcy Prediction and Detection using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research study presents a comprehensive use of machine learning techniques used for bankruptcy prediction, which is crucial for financial institutions to assess creditworthiness. The study highlights methods such as logistic regression, decision trees, and ensemble learning (bagging, boosting), demonstrating the superiority of machine learning over classical statistics for smaller datasets. This study compares various strategies by considering financial statements, market trends, industry benchmarks, and macroeconomic indicators. Integrating diverse data sources helps identify risk factors and signs of financial distress, guiding proactive bankruptcy prevention measures. These include optimizing cash flow, enhancing efficiency, diversifying revenue, and implementing early warning systems. Predicting and preventing bankruptcies support financial stability, job protection, and economic growth. The proposed model employs financial ratios and relevant data to predict bankruptcy likelihood, which is evaluated using assessment and evaluation metrics. The AdaBoost model has a reported accuracy of 86.36% and an F1 score of 85.93%, which are higher than those of all the other cohorts included in the existing work.

articleTitle: Resnet-53 for Alzheimer's Disease Detection from MRI Images and Analysis with SVM Tuning with Hyper Optimization Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The research utilizes a dataset containing biomarkers and cognitive traits, utilizing advanced machine learning algorithms for early detection and accurate diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease globally. Gaussian filter and bilateral filter to produce an adaptive filter, combining it with Gaussian filtering allows the model to optimize the smoothing and enhancement process depending on local characteristics by adaptively filtering various sections of the picture. After reducing the noise from the images, this output is given to the RESNET for extraction of features from the images. Here, the customized three layers of RESENT-50 to RESNET-53. As a result, feature learning may become more efficient and discriminative. Brain biomarkers can be used to classify patients using information from multi-modal imaging, such as DTI and structural MRI. CNN techniques have been shown to be effective tools for enhancing image-based classification recently. In order to reduce residual errors, the process begins with the extraction of features using ResNet, with a preference for skipping connections. ResNet50 was selected because to its outstanding picture analysis and classification skills. The model's parameters are adjusted in accordance with the difference between the predicted and actual class scores. The SVM model is fine-tuned in the final layer, particularly with regard to Alzheimer's detection for binary and multiclass assignments. In order to improve the model's performance on the validation set, Bayesian optimization using Hyperopt methodically investigates the hyperparameter space by improving parameters like regularization and kernel selection. In this proposed work, we have used transfer learning with Resnet-Based Image Analysis with SVM Tuning to conduct different classification of Alzheimer disease. These kinds of representations are learnable from the data using deep learning algorithms. The SVM model is fine-tuned in the final layer, particularly with regard to Alzheimer's disease detection for multiple lables. To improve the model's performance the validation set, Bayesian optimization using Hyperopt methodically investigates the hyperparameter space by improving parameters like regularization and kernel selection. Including the use of multimodal data improves the model's durability and offers a thorough and dependable early detection tool.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Blob Detection Techniques Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Blob detection is a primary requirement in computer vision and image processing tasks. Unique visual traits are obtained by identifying blobs in an image. Variations in colour, texture, intensity, or shape are just examples of these attributes, which make blob detection a flexible tool for a variety of image analysis applications. The technique of separating the objects in the binary image is called Binary Large Object (blob) extraction. Every representation technique provides distinct insights into the properties of the blob, which facilitates further processing and interpretation. Techniques for classifying blobs according to their size, shape, texture, and colour are presented, highlighting their importance involving object recognition and classification. The categorization of blob detection techniques presented in this work includes, encompassing Laplacian of Gaussian (LoG), Difference of Gaussian (DoG), Difference of Hessian (DOH), and Connected Components (Labelling). The results demonstrate that LoG and DoG detect a higher number of blobs, with LoG detecting the most (1,366 blobs), while DoH focuses on larger blobs but with a smaller count (777 blobs). Moreover, DoH had the largest mean blob size and higher variability in blob size, while DoG exhibited the fastest detection time (4.27 seconds).

articleTitle: IoT and Cloud-based Solutions for Energy-Efficient Restroom Lighting Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research study introduces a new way to improve the energy efficiency of restroom lighting systems by combining cloud-based solutions with Internet of Things (IoT) technologies. Traditional toilet lighting systems waste much energy since flexible or optimized. Our suggested solution is to use IoT devices like ambient light sensors and motion detectors to regulate lighting in response to occupancy and daylight smartly. In real-time, advanced techniques examine trends in the data sent by these sensors and optimize the lighting schedule on a platform in the cloud. Our technology optimizes energy usage while simultaneously improving user comfort and convenience via the dynamic adjustment of lighting levels and the automatic switching of lights in unoccupied areas. Using simulations and real-world trials shows that our method is feasible and successful, with particular emphasis on improving sustainability in restrooms while significantly reducing energy use. Its findings highlight the promise of IoT and cloud computing in promoting sustainability in various settings and developing more energy-efficient building management systems. The challenges include providing continuous connection, maintaining sensor accuracy, controlling data security, seamlessly integrating technologies, and providing various user needs in diverse environments.

articleTitle: RGCNN: Precise Fake News Detection on Social Media Using Random Group Coupled Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The explosion of unverified information on social media platforms has made it more important than ever to identify and anticipate false news, which poses serious hazards to democratic processes and society as a whole. The challenge is exacerbated by the lack of standardized benchmark datasets, which impedes the development of effective countermeasures against misinformation. This research introduces a novel approach for fake news classification and prediction through the Random-Coupled Neural Network with a Group Teaching Algorithm (RGCNN). Data is sourced from the LIAR and ISOT datasets and undergoes comprehensive preprocessing, including tokenization, data cleaning, removal of stopwords, stemming, and lemmatization. Feature extraction is performed using a Split Multi-Axis Vision Transformer. The Random-Coupled Neural Network (RCNN) is utilized for precise fake news detection, with its performance further refined by applying Group Teaching Optimization (GTO). 99.6% on the LIAR dataset and 99.5% on the ISOT dataset show how accurate the suggested method is.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Hybrid Framework Utilizing OpenCV and CNN for Automated Brain Tumor Detection and MRI Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Sustainable Expert Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Brain tumors constitute a significant public health issue worldwide, affecting not only individuals patients but also healthcare infrastructures. Recently, the prevalence of brain and other central nervous system cancers has shown alarming trends. World health statistics show that each year, tens of thousands of people in the United States are diagnosed with brain cancer, with gliomas accounting for a significant portion of these cases. Gliomas exhibit a wide spectrum of severity and prognostic outcomes, positioning brain cancer as one of the most significant challenges faced by the medical community.
